blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Systems that aim to help a user engage with viewpoints other than their own have to decide how different those viewpoints should be. Viewpoints are mainly represented on a scalar scale, too coarse to distinguish viewpoints that disagree with the user about different things. We introduce a selection policy in which a bandit sets how far viewpoints may sit from the user, and the policy selects the most novel viewpoint within that bound. We vary only its stance encoder, comparing a scalar score with Perspectivized Stance Vectors, which break a position into separate stances on concepts. We integrate it inside a dialog system and run a between-subjects study (N=63). Concept-level stance produces more varied exposure sequences and broader coverage of the topic's positions, but does not change how deeply users justify viewpoints or how accurately they reconstruct them. Finally, we analyze user--viewpoint relations at the concept level, showing that users reconstruct a viewpoint least accurately on concepts that one side took no position on, rather than on concepts where the two disagreed. Our findings open up opportunities for dialog systems that support engagement with alternative viewpoints by acting on which concepts a user and a viewpoint disagree on, rather than on distance alone.
blocks.zh: 旨在帮助用户表达自己不同观点的系统必须决定这些观点应如何不同。 视图点主要以scalar比例表示,过于粗糙,无法区分不同事物上与用户有分歧的观点. 我们实行一种选择政策,由土匪确定与使用者的观点可能相距多远,而政策则在其中选择最新颖的观点。 我们只改变它的立场编码器, 比较一个标分 和Perspectified Stance Vectors, 它打破了一个位置 在概念上 分开的立场。 我们把它整合在一个对话系统中,并进行一个学科间研究(N=63)。 概念层面的立场产生更多样化的曝光顺序和对专题立场的更广泛涵盖,但并不改变用户如何深刻地说明观点的合理性或如何准确地重建观点。 最后,我们在概念层面分析用户-观点关系,显示用户对一方没有立场的概念,而不是对双方意见不一的概念,重建最准确的观点。 我们的研究结果为对话系统提供了机会,这些系统支持采用其他观点,其做法是,一个用户和观点在哪些概念上存在分歧,而不只是在距离问题上。

blocks.en:
Public discourse increasingly takes place in information environments such as social media feeds, search results and recommender systems, where people selectively encounter views consistent with their existing positions ( Frey, 1986 ; Zarouali et al., 2021 ) .
In politically contentious settings this is associated with affective polarization, which increases hostility toward opposing groups and reduces willingness to interact with them ( Iyengar and Westwood, 2015 ; Iyengar et al., 2019 ) .
One response is to structure exposure to perspectives other than a user’s own, drawing on perspective-taking, the process of understanding a situation from another person’s point of view ( Reniers et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh:
公共言论越来越多地发生在信息环境中,如社交媒体反馈、搜索结果和推荐系统,人们在那里有选择地遇到与其现有立场一致的观点(Frey,1986年;Zarouali等人,2021年)。
在政治争议环境中,这与情感两极分化有关,这种两极分化增加了对对立团体的敌意,减少了与这些团体互动的意愿(Iyengar和Westwood,2015年;Iyengar等人,2019年)。
一种反应是从另一个人的角度来理解某种情况的过程。

blocks.en:
Providing alternative views is not sufficient on its own, because the relation between a new view and a person’s existing position shapes how they process it ( Lewandowsky et al., 2012 ; Zhou and Shen, 2024 ) .
A view close to what a user already holds adds little, while one far from it may be dismissed rather than considered ( Sherif and Hovland, 1961 ) .
Which views a user sees should therefore depend on where that user stands, and several systems select on this basis, choosing what to
show next from the arguments a user has already been exposed to ( Aicher et al., 2022 ; Aicher et al., 2023a ; Aicher et al., 2023b ) .
Such a system compares each candidate viewpoint with the user’s own position, and a viewpoint can differ from that position in two ways. It can differ in degree, by opposing the user more or less strongly, and in kind, by opposing a different aspect of the issue. Which of these differences a system selects on is an open question.
blocks.zh:
提供另类观点本身并不足够,因为新观点与一个人的现有立场之间的关系决定了他们如何处理它(Lewandowsky等人,2012年;周和沈,2024年)。
与用户已经持有的观点相近的观点没有多大增加,而远处的观点可能被否定而不是考虑(Sherif和Hovland,1961年)。
因此,一个用户所看到的查看应取决于该用户所处的位置,并在此基础上选择几个系统,选择什么
显示用户已接触到的参数(Aicher等人,2022年;Aicher等人,2023年a年;Aicher等人,2023年b年b年b年)。
这种系统将每个候选人的观点与用户自己的立场进行比较,一种观点可以从两个方面与该立场不同。 它在程度上可以不同,或多或少强烈反对用户,或以实物形式反对问题的不同方面. 系统所选择的这些差异中哪一个是一个未决问题。

blocks.en:
How a system represents stance of a viewpoint decides which of the two it can act on at all.
Stance is usually summarised as a single point on an ordinal scale running from opposing to supporting a position, which records degree and discards kind.
Two viewpoints that oppose different aspects of an issue can land on the same point of that scale, and a system comparing them with a user sees one value for both.
Figure 1 shows this for hunting. Both viewpoints sit two steps from the user’s position, so a system using the Scalar scale has no basis for preferring either, even though the aspects they disagree with the user about are not the same. A system that cannot see a difference cannot select on it, whatever rule it applies.
blocks.zh:
一个系统如何代表一种观点的立场,决定它能对哪一种观点采取行动。
Stance通常被概括为从对立到支持位置的正弦尺度上的单点,它记录了程度和丢弃类型.
两种反对某一问题不同方面的观点可以在同一尺度的同一点上落下,一个系统将它们与一个用户相比较,就认为两者都有一个价值。
图1显示这是狩猎用的。 两种观点都位于用户位置的两步之外,因此,使用Scalar比例表的系统也没有任何偏好依据,尽管他们与用户的分歧并不相同。 无法看到差异的系统不能在上面选择,不管它适用什么规则.

blocks.en:
Finer representations do exist. Perspectivized Stance Vectors ( Psv ), for example, record a separate stance toward each of several concepts in an issue ( Plenz et al., 2025 ) , so two viewpoints that oppose different aspects receive different vectors (Figure 1 , right).
What such a representation changes for a user has not been tested, because a system that adopts a new representation normally changes the rule that uses it at the same time, leaving the two effects confounded.
We therefore keep selection policy–the rule that decides which viewpoint to show next– fixed and swap only the stance representation underneath it, comparing a single ordinal score ( Scalar ) with Perspectivized Stance Vectors ( Psv ).
We implement this policy in a dialog system that presents the selected viewpoints and asks users about each of them.
blocks.zh:
更精细的表述的确存在. 例如,对一个问题(Plenz等人,2025年)中若干概念的单独立场(Psv),因此两个反对不同方面的观点得到不同的矢量(图1,右)。
对于一个用户来说,这种表示的变化是什么,还没有经过测试,因为采用新表示的系统通常会改变同时使用这种表示的规则,使两种效果陷于困惑。
因此,我们坚持选择政策 — — 即决定下一步要显示何种观点的规则 — — 固定并只交换其下方的姿态代表,将单一的正弦比分(Scalar)与Perspectified Stance Vectors(Psv)进行比较。
我们在一个对话系统中执行这项政策,该对话系统将介绍选定的观点,并向用户询问每个观点。

blocks.en:
Isolating the representation in this way lets us ask three questions. RQ1: How does representing stance at the concept level, rather than as a single score, change the viewpoints shown to a user? RQ2: Does concept-level stance representation affect how fully users justify viewpoints and how accurately they reconstruct them? RQ3: How does the concept-level relation between a user’s stance and a viewpoint’s stance relate to reconstruction accuracy? Answering them contributes a viewpoint-selection policy that operates over interchangeable stance representations, an account of
what each representation makes available both to users and across the full stance space, and a concept-level analysis of reconstruction that a single aggregate score leaves hidden.
blocks.zh:
以这种方式孤立代表让我们提出三个问题。 RQ1:在概念层面,而不是作为单一的分数,如何改变显示给用户的观点? RQ2:概念层面的立场表述是否影响到用户如何充分说明观点的合理性,以及他们如何准确地重建观点? RQ3:用户的立场和观点之间的概念级关系与重建的准确性有什么关系? 回答这些问题有助于采取一种选择观点的政策,这种政策超越了可互换的立场表述,说明
每一个表达方式都为用户和整个位置空间提供哪些信息,以及对重建进行概念层面的分析,即一个整体得分会隐藏。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Selecting viewpoints for a particular user draws on three lines of work.
Argument retrieval defines how candidates are found.
User-conditioned selection makes that choice depend on the recipient and on what they have already seen.
Work on stance supplies the signal that relates a candidate to a user.
We review each below, asking in each case how the relation between a user and a candidate viewpoint is represented, since that representation is what we vary.
blocks.zh:
选择特定用户的观点借鉴了三行工作.
参数检索定义了如何找到候选人 。
用户有条件的选择使得这种选择取决于接受者以及他们已经看到的东西.
姿势方面的工作向用户传递一个候选人的信号。
我们回顾下面的每一个情况,询问每个情况如何反映用户与候选人观点之间的关系,因为我们的这种代表性各不相同。

blocks.en:
Argument retrieval finds arguments relevant to a query, including arguments with particular argumentative properties ( Wachsmuth et al., 2018 ) .
Argument recommendation conditions that selection on the recipient. Brenneis et al. ( Brenneis et al., 2021 ) introduce a dataset for evaluating argument recommenders from personal attitudes and interactions with arguments, more recent work incorporates user or stakeholder perspectives ( Heinisch et al., 2024 ; Aicher et al., 2022 ) , and PerspectiveArg2024 formulates perspective-aware argument selection as a retrieval task ( Falk et al., 2024 ) .
These approaches establish user and perspective information as retrieval signals, but differ in how they represent the relation between a user and a candidate argument.
blocks.zh:
辩证检索发现与查询相关的论据,包括具有特定辩证性质的论据(Wachsmuth等人,2018年).
论证性建议对接受方作出选择。 Brenneis等人著. (Brenneis等人,2021年)引入了一个数据集,用于从个人态度和与论据的相互作用中评价论证推荐者,近期的工作纳入了用户或利益攸关方的观点(Heinisch等人,2024年;Aicher等人,2022年),PerspectArg2024将视角意识论证选择作为一种检索任务(Falk等人,2024年).
这些方法将用户和视角信息确立为检索信号,但在如何代表用户与候选论据之间的关系方面有所不同.

blocks.en:
Selection can also unfold over a conversation, with the user’s current state and the arguments already shown affecting what comes next.
Aicher et al. ( Aicher et al., 2022 ; Aicher et al., 2023b ) model exposure histories and user positions in argumentative dialog systems to identify arguments that broaden subsequent exposure, showing that selection can operate as a policy over an evolving interaction rather than as one-shot retrieval. Our policy similarly selects over a session rather than in one shot.
blocks.zh:
选择也可以通过对话展开, 用户的当前状态和已经显示的参数会影响接下来的情况 。
Aicher 等 (英语). (Aicher等人,2022年;Aicher等人,2023年b) 论证性对话系统中的模型曝光历史和用户位置,以识别拓宽后续曝光的论据,表明选择可以作为一个政策运作,而不是一个不断变化的互动,而不是一个镜头的检索. 同样,我们的政策是选择一个会议而不是一个机会。

blocks.en:
Stance provides a direct signal for distinguishing arguments in controversial discussions. Methods exist for identifying the position expressed toward a topic or target ( Durmus et al., 2019 ; Kobbe et al., 2020 ) , and
stance has been incorporated into retrieval and ranking through stance-aware query expansion ( Kiesel et al., 2021 ) and stance-aware re-ranking for comparative retrieval ( Reimer et al., 2023 ) .
These approaches treat stance as a property attached to an argument. In our setting stance instead defines the space in which candidates are compared, so that the distance between a user’s stance and a candidate determines eligibility and the stance
representation determines which differences a policy can distinguish.
blocks.zh:
Stance为在有争议的讨论中区分论点提供了直接信号. 确定对某一专题或目标表达的立场的方法已经存在(Durmus等人,2019年;Kobbe等人,2020年),以及
通过提高姿态意识的查询扩展(Kiesel等人,2021年)和重新调整姿态意识以进行比较检索(Reimer等人,2023年),将姿态纳入了检索和排名。
这些办法将立场视为一种论点所附带的财产。 在我们的设定立场中,确定比较候选人的空间,以便用户的立场与候选人之间的距离决定资格和立场
代表性决定政策可以区分哪些差异。

blocks.en:
Conditioning on stance distance is supported by work on how arguments are processed.
Social Judgment Theory models messages relative to a receiver’s existing position ( Sherif and Hovland, 1961 ) , and studies of belief revision and misinformation show that the discrepancy between incoming information and prior beliefs affects how that information is processed ( Durmus and Cardie, 2018 ; Zhao and Fink, 2021 ; Lewandowsky et al., 2012 ) .
This literature motivates conditioning selection on user–viewpoint distance without specifying how that distance should be represented.
blocks.zh:
关于立场距离的附加条件得到了如何处理论据的工作的支持。
社会判决 有关接收者现有位置的理论模型信息(Sherif and Hovland,1961年),以及对信仰修正和错误信息的研究显示,收到的信息与先前的信仰之间的差异影响了这些信息的处理方式(Durmus and Cardie,2018年;Zhao and Fink,2021年;Lewandowsky等人,2012年)。
这种文献激发了对用户-视图点距离选择的限定,而没有具体说明该距离应如何表示。

blocks.en:
A compact stance representation characterizes an argument’s position toward a target, but collapses distinctions between positions on different aspects of an issue. Plenz et al. ( Plenz et al., 2025 ) address this with Perspectivized Stance Vectors, which represent an argument through its stances toward a shared set of issue-specific concepts, making agreement and
disagreement explicit at the level of individual concepts. They use concept-level stance to analyze agreement between arguments after retrieval. We use it instead as the representation over which a viewpoint-selection policy operates.
blocks.zh:
一种紧凑的姿态代表了一种论点对目标的立场,但打破了对一个问题不同方面的立场的区别。 普伦兹等人. (Plenz等人,2025年)用Perspectified Stance Vectors来解决这一问题,这代表了它通过对一套针对特定问题的共同概念的立场而提出的一个论点,即达成一致和
在个别概念层面有明确分歧。 他们使用概念级的立场,在检索后分析各种论点之间的一致. 我们用它来代表观点选择政策的运作。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We formulate viewpoint selection as a retrieval problem over a fixed corpus of viewpoints. Our methodology represents the stance of the participant and candidate viewpoints, computes their distance in the resulting stance space, and uses this distance together with novelty to select and order five viewpoints. We integrate this selection policy into a dialog system that encodes the participant’s free-text stance and presents the selected viewpoints. Figure 2 illustrates this selection framework. The remainder of this section describes the viewpoint corpus, stance representations, selection policy, and the dialog system.

blocks.en: 3.1 Viewpoint Corpus
blocks.zh: 3.1 视图点公司

blocks.en:
We use the animal-hunting corpus of Plenz et al. (2025) , drawn from Debate.org. After filtering, the corpus contains 364 viewpoints (Appendix A ). The original corpus provides Perspectivized Stance Vectors (PSVs) over 100 concepts.
For selection we reduce this to a fixed five-concept signature, hunt game , hunter , while hunting animals , outdoor activity and good .
Concepts were ranked by how much their stance varies across the corpus, how often they take a non-neutral stance, and how well they separate pro from con arguments, and the top five were retained
(Appendix B ).
The reduction preserves the structure of the full 100-concept representation, which yields a closely matching clustering of the corpus (adjusted Rand index .92 .92 ).

blocks.en: 3.2 Stance Representations
blocks.zh: 3.2 Stance 代表

blocks.en: A stance representation encodes a position so that two positions can be compared numerically. We compare a scalar representation with a concept-level representation based on PSVs.

This representation distinguishes five overall positions but does not encode which aspects of the issue produce the difference.

blocks.en: Distance and novelty serve complementary purposes. The distance bound limits how far a viewpoint may differ from the participant, measured as the difference between overall ratings under Scalar and the L 1 L_{1} distance between concept-level stance vectors under Psv . blocks.en: The stance representation determines how both criteria operate. Scalar encodes five overall positions and assigns one feature to each viewpoint, making novelty binary. At any given distance from the participant, at most two scalar positions are possible. blocks.en: 4.1 Study Design and Procedure
blocks.zh: 4.1 研究设计和程序

blocks.en:
We conducted a between-subjects study on Should animal hunting be allowed? .
The study was online.
Participants first completed a consent form, the perspective-taking subscale of the Interpersonal Reactivity Index (IRI-PT) ( Davis, 1983 ) , and wrote their own view on the issue as free-text. Then they interacted with the dialog system (Section 3.3 ), followed by the reconstruction task (Section 4.3 ).

blocks.en: 5.1 Concept-Level Stance Individualizes and Broadens Exposure
blocks.zh: 5.1 概念层面的个性化和广泛接触

blocks.en:
RQ1 asks how concept-level stance representation changes the viewpoints shown to participants.
Figure 3 shows each viewpoint’s distance from the participant in the representation used for selection.
Because the panels use different scales, we compare counts rather than distances across conditions. We count distinct distance sequences, each defined by the five distances in presentation order; sessions with the same distance sequence count as one even if they show different viewpoints.

The 31 Scalar sessions produced 6 distinct distance sequences, compared with 24 across the 32 Psv sessions. Under Scalar , the first viewpoint matched the participant’s stance in all 31 sessions, the second was one step away in all 31, and the third was one step away in 27. The fourth and fifth returned to the participant’s stance in 23 and 26 sessions, respectively.
The sequence is fully determined by the participant’s stance and the distance bound, with each of the 9 observed combinations

Under Psv the first viewpoint matched the participant on all five concepts in 20/32 sessions. The
second sat at the furthest distance the bound allowed in 27/32, after which distance fell across the remaining slots, with means of 7.1, 6.1, 3.6 and 2.5 at slots 2 to 5.

At each sequence position, participant distance was strongly correlated with the number of newly introduced concept–stance combinations under both Psv ( ρ = .72 \rho=.72 – .95 .95 ) and Scalar ( ρ = .73 \rho=.73 – 1.00 1.00 ), where both measures varied.

To test whether these patterns depended on the participants sampled, we replayed the deployed policy across the full corpus for all possible participant positions, 5 scalar ratings and 243 Psv profiles. At the widest bound, Psv covered all 15 combinations in every run, compared with a mean of 12.7 (SD 1.2) under Scalar , which covered all 15 in only 5% of runs (Appendix G ). At the narrowest bound, mean coverage was 9.1 under Psv and 8.3 under Scalar ; Psv selected the nearest unseen viewpoint as a fallback in 52.5% of selections. The corpus contained at most two scalar rating levels at any given distance, compared with a median of 6–12 Psv profiles at each L 1 L_{1} distance from 4 to 8.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: We investigated whether the stance representation a policy uses to select viewpoints changes what a user encounters and what they take away from it.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了一种政策用来选择观点的立场是否改变了用户遇到的问题和他们从中夺走的东西。

blocks.en:
In RQ1 , we investigated whether representing stance at the concept level, rather than as a single score, changes which viewpoints are selected. It does.
Both conditions ran the same selection policy, so the difference came from the encoder alone, Psv produced 24 distinct exposure sequences against 6 under Scalar , and participants encountered more of the concept–stance combinations available on the topic. Replaying the deployed policy over the full corpus and all possible participant positions shows the same pattern.
While prior work has either surfaced diverse opinions without selecting relative to the user ( Freelon et al., 2012 ; Kim et al., 2021 ) , or selected relative to the user while treating the stance encoding as given ( Aicher et al., 2022 ; Aicher et al., 2023b ) , our results indicate that the stance representation itself shapes selection behavior by defining which distinctions the policy can make between viewpoints.
blocks.zh:
在RQ1中,我们调查了在概念层面是否代表立场,而不是作为一个单一的分数,选择了哪些观点。 没错
两种条件都实行相同的选择政策,因此差异来自编码器本身,Psv在Scalar下产生了24个不同的曝光序列,对6个接触序列,与会者在该专题上遇到了更多的概念-常态组合。 将已部署的政策重放于全部人员以及所有可能的参与者职位上,显示了同样的模式。
虽然先前的作品要么浮现了不同的意见,而没有选择与用户的相对关系(Freelon等人,2012年;Kim等人,2021年),要么选择了与用户的相对关系,同时按给定的处理姿势编码(Aicher等人,2022年;Aicher等人,2023年b),但我们的结果显示,姿势代表本身通过定义政策可以作出何种区分来塑造选择行为.

blocks.en:
Our second research question ( RQ2 ) asked whether this difference in exposure carried through to how deeply participants justified the viewpoints they encountered and how accurately they reconstructed them. It did not, on either measure, but our study was powered to detect only large effects.
This is consistent with ( Saveski et al., 2022 ) , who found that exposure to opposing political content did not improve participants’ reported understanding of why others held those views.
In our study, exposure was deliberately structured and every viewpoint was followed by fixed Socratic style questions, yet reconstruction still did not differ between conditions.
Showing participants a wider range of viewpoints did not help them reconstruct those viewpoints more accurately.
blocks.zh:
我们的第二个研究问题(RQ2)问道,这种接触方面的差别是否一直延续到参与者如何深刻地证明他们遇到的观点是合理的,以及他们如何准确地加以重建。 它没有,无论是哪种措施, 但我们的研究只有力量来检测大的影响。
这符合(Saveski等人,2022年),他发现,暴露于对立的政治内容并不能改善与会者对其他人为何持有这些观点的理解。
在我们的研究中,暴露是有意安排的,每一个观点之后都会有固定的索克拉底风格问题,然而重建仍然没有因条件而异.
向与会者展示更广泛的观点无助于他们更准确地重建这些观点。

blocks.en:
In RQ3 , we investigated which parts of a viewpoint participants reconstructed correctly, and how this depended on their own stance. Participants were about as accurate on concepts where they opposed the viewpoint as on concepts where they agreed with it, and markedly less accurate where either side held no position.
Accuracy declined as the overall stance distance increased, consistent with the discrepancy account of Sherif and Hovland (1961) . However, the most frequent reconstruction error was to label an opposing stance as neutral, and neutral positions were the hardest to reconstruct. This suggests that stance discrepancy may affect not only how a viewpoint is judged, but also how its specific claims are understood and remembered.
blocks.zh:
在RQ3中,我们调查了观点参与者的哪些部分重建得正确,以及这如何取决于他们自己的立场。 与会者对反对观点的概念和赞同观点的概念的看法十分准确,对任何一方均不持立场的概念则明显不准确。
随着整体姿态距离的扩大,准确性下降,这与Sherif和Hovland(1961年)的矛盾说法是一致的。 然而,最经常发生的重建错误是把对立的立场贴上中立的标签,中立的立场是最难重建的. 这表明,立场上的差异不仅可能影响对一种观点的判断,而且可能影响对其具体主张的理解和记忆。

blocks.en: These findings have implications for dialog systems that select viewpoints for a user. Breadth and stance discrepancy should be treated separately, since novelty relative to the user can favor the most distant viewpoints. A policy could instead target a particular stance distance and select the most novel viewpoint within that range, provided the representation distinguishes multiple viewpoints at the same distance. Our policy keeps the distance bound fixed within each session. Future work could explore within-session adaptation, updating this bound in response to user interaction to balance novelty and discrepancy dynamically.
blocks.zh: 这些结论对为用户选择观点的对话系统有影响。 面包和姿势差异应当分别处理,因为相对于用户而言,新颖性可以偏向最远的观点. 相反,政策可以针对特定的立场距离,并在这一范围内选择最新颖的观点,但代表必须在同一距离上区分多种观点。 我们的政策是将距离固定在每次会议之内。 今后的工作可以探讨会内调整,根据用户的互动情况更新这一约束,以动态地平衡新颖性和差异。

blocks.en:
Polarization on contested issues is a long-standing societal problem. With this work we aim to contribute to supporting users in encountering and engaging with viewpoints other than their own.
We integrate this support into a dialog system, a type of system many people are now familiar with, and show that the stance representation a policy uses determines which disagreements a user is able to meet.
This opens up opportunities for dialog systems that broaden what users encounter on contested issues while remaining accountable for which
dimensions of disagreement they act upon on.

在有争议的问题上实行两极分化是一个长期存在的社会问题。 通过这项工作,我们致力于支持用户接触和接触他们自己以外的观点。
我们把这种支持整合到一个对话系统之中,这个系统是许多人现在熟悉的,并表明政策使用的立场决定了用户能够遇到的分歧。
这为对话系统提供了机会,使用户在有争议的问题上遇到更多的问题,同时继续对这些问题负责。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We presented a viewpoint-selection policy that operates over interchangeable stance representations, allowing us to vary the representation while keeping the selection rule fixed. Evaluating it with 63 participants and by replaying it across the full stance space, we showed that representation shapes which differences the system can act on. Concept-level selection produced more varied exposure and broader topic coverage, but did not change justification depth or overall reconstruction accuracy. Concept-level analysis showed that participants reconstructed neutral concepts less accurately than concepts on which they agreed or disagreed with a viewpoint, a distinction obscured by overall accuracy.
Our findings establish stance representation as a design choice in viewpoint selection. This opens a direction for systems that control how far a viewpoint is from a user separately from which specific disagreements it raises.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了一种观点选择政策,其运作方式超越了可互换的立场代表制,使我们能够改变代表制,同时使选择规则保持不变。 我们用63个参与者来评价它,并通过在全方位的空间中重新审视它,我们显示了这种代表形式,而这种代表形式使系统能够采取行动。 概念一级的选择产生了更多不同的曝光和更广泛的专题覆盖面,但没有改变理由的深度或总体重建准确性。 概念层面的分析表明,与会者重构中性概念的准确性低于他们同意或不同意某种观点的概念,这种区分被总体准确性所掩盖。
我们的调查结果将立场代表确定为观点选择的设计选择。 这为控制某一观点与某一用户的不同程度的系统打开了一个方向,而该观点与用户所产生的具体分歧是不同的。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Our findings have several limitations. First, the study focused on a single contested issue, one language, and a corpus of user-contributed viewpoints, so the results may not generalize to other topics or content sources.
Second, the concept-level representation used a fixed signature of five concepts selected during system development; different concepts or issues may produce different selection patterns.
Third, reconstruction required participants to report a viewpoint’s stance on each concept, which may conflate their understanding of its position with their recall of its content.
Finally, the study involved 63 participants and was powered to detect only large effects in the condition comparison. The absence of differences in justification depth and reconstruction accuracy therefore does not establish that the representations are equivalent on these outcomes.
blocks.zh:
我们的调查结果有几个局限性。 首先,研究侧重于一个有争议的单一问题,一种语言,以及一系列由用户提供的观点,因此,研究结果可能无法概括到其他专题或内容来源。
第二,概念层代表使用系统开发过程中选定的五个概念的固定签名;不同的概念或问题可能产生不同的选择模式.
第三,重建要求参与者报告对每个概念的看法,这可能将他们对它的立场的理解与对它的内容的回顾混为一谈。
最后,该项研究有63名参加者参加,并授权在条件比较中只探测到重大影响。 因此,在理由的深度和重建的准确性方面没有差别,不能证明这些陈述在这些结果上是等同的。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
This study was approved by the Human Research Ethics Committee of our university. All participants provided consent before participation.
The dialog system offered no opinions or advice of its own and generated no arguments.
That said, both selecting viewpoints close to the user’s position and selecting ones far from them can have their own consequences, and deployment of our proposed approach on more controversial and sensitive topics and in real-world settings may therefore need further ethical considerations and approvals.
blocks.zh:
本研究获得我国大学人类研究伦理委员会批准. 所有与会者在与会前都表示同意。
对话系统没有提出自己的意见或建议,也没有引起任何争论。
尽管如此,选择与用户立场相近的观点和选择远离它们的观点都可能产生自己的后果,因此,在现实世界中应用我们提议的关于更具争议性和敏感性的专题的方法可能需要进一步的道德考虑和认可。

blocks.en: Appendix F Determinism of the Scalar Sequences
blocks.zh: 附录F 斯卡尔序列的决定因素

blocks.en: Section 5.1 reports that under Scalar the sequence of distances follows from the participant’s stance and the distance bound. This appendix derives that sequence and checks it against the sessions.
blocks.zh: 第5.1节报告说,在斯卡拉尔语下,距离的顺序与参与者的立场和距离有联系。 本附录根据届会顺序加以核对。

blocks.en:
Let s s be the participant’s stance level and δ \delta the bound. Under Scalar a viewpoint carries one stance feature, its level, so novelty is binary and the policy of Section 3.3 reduces to three steps. First, the eligible levels are those within δ \delta of s s . Second, the policy shows an eligible level that has not been shown yet, taking the nearest one when several remain. Third, once every eligible level has been shown, novelty is zero for all candidates and the tie-break on distance returns the level nearest s s ,
which is s s itself. Several corpus viewpoints share each level, so which text a slot shows varies, but its distance does not.
blocks.zh:
让我们成为参与者的立场, 在斯卡拉尔语下,观点具有一个姿态特征,其水平,所以新颖性是二进制,第3.3节的政策缩减为三个步骤. 第一,符合资格的级别是S.S.的\delta。 第二,政策显示的合格水平尚未显示,在几个方面采用最接近的水平。 第三,一旦每个合格级别被显示,所有候选人的新颖性为0,距离的比对折返回最接近的S,
这是S本身。 多个实体观点共享每个关卡,所以一个槽显示的文本不同,但其距离却不同.
